label: Socketed Edge
deprecated_reason: Deprecated with the rest of the socket pool family: the socket module's socket_item pool is not yet proven to produce a legal exclusive-family draw, so a single-option pool would make a gem's affix deterministic.

label: Socketed Ward

label: Socketed Force
deprecated_reason: A two-option socket_slot pool starved empty-slot imputation: both slots drew from the same two exclusive families and an eligible imprint could not be found. Kept deprecated until the derived pools enforce a minimum membership for an imputation pool.
